Privacy Policy

How this portfolio handles visitor information and TikTok data.

Last updated September 10, 2026

1. Who this policy covers

This policy describes information handling for Milo's personal portfolio, operated under @nerdyleclerc. It covers visitors to the site and the portfolio owner's authorized TikTok data. You do not need an account to browse the portfolio.

2. Information from visitors

This site does not provide visitor registration, payment forms, or a form to connect visitors' TikTok accounts. The current site does not include its own advertising trackers or analytics scripts, and does not use cookies or local storage to track visitors. The private owner connection flow uses essential, secure cookies to validate forms and TikTok authorization callbacks; these expire after ten minutes and are not used for advertising.

Loading the site or its API sends ordinary technical information, such as your IP address, browser information, requested URL, and request time, to the hosting provider. This information may be processed in access, operational, and security logs to deliver and protect the service.

If you contact me, I receive the information you choose to send, such as your profile name, message, and contact details. I use it to respond and handle your request.

3. TikTok information

When the portfolio owner's account is connected, the site uses authorized, read-only TikTok API access to retrieve the display name, follower count, total likes, public video count, and the most recent public video's identifier, caption or title, publication time, share link, and aggregate likes, comments, views, and shares.

This information is used to display the portfolio owner's work and statistics publicly. The integration does not retrieve visitors' TikTok data, private messages, follower identities, or the text or authors of individual comments. It does not publish videos or take actions on visitors' behalf.

The owner's access and refresh tokens are obtained through TikTok's consent flow and encrypted before storage in Upstash Redis, along with the account's app-scoped identifier, granted permissions, and token expiry times. The server uses these tokens to authenticate requests and renew access. These tokens are not included in the site's public API response. Visitors should never submit credentials or tokens to this site.

4. Hosting, fonts, and embedded videos

  • Vercel: hosts the website and its server endpoint and may process technical request and security information. See Vercel's Privacy Policy.
  • Upstash: stores encrypted owner authorization records and temporary security state so the TikTok connection can work across server requests. Access is restricted to the server. See Upstash’s Privacy Policy.
  • Google Fonts: supplies the Inter font. Your browser connects to Google to request font files, which can disclose your IP address and technical request information. See Google Fonts' privacy information.
  • TikTok: supplies the account data and embedded player. When the player loads or you interact with it, your browser communicates directly with TikTok. TikTok may receive your IP address, device or browser information and interactions, and may use cookies or similar technology under its own policies. See TikTok's Privacy Policy.

Following a link to X or another external site is subject to that service's privacy practices. These providers may process information in countries other than the one where you live.

5. Storage and retention

The site temporarily caches TikTok responses in server memory. Fresh results are normally reused for about 60 seconds; during a temporary error, previously fetched results may be shown for up to 15 minutes and marked as delayed. An in-memory copy is replaced on a later successful fetch or discarded when the server instance ends. There is no separate application database of TikTok responses in the current implementation.

Encrypted connection records remain in Upstash Redis until the owner disconnects or deletes them. Tokens are replaced when renewed. Disconnecting deletes the local connection and attempts to revoke the app's access at TikTok; the owner is notified if TikTok cannot confirm revocation. Temporary form and OAuth state records expire after ten minutes or are consumed when used. Hosting logs are retained according to the hosting provider's applicable settings and policies. Contact messages are kept as needed to respond, resolve the issue, and meet applicable obligations; the messaging provider may retain its own copies.

6. Purpose, sharing, and security

Information is handled to deliver the portfolio, display the owner's authorized public content, maintain security, and respond to messages. The site does not sell personal information or use TikTok data for advertising or profiling. The owner's public TikTok information is intentionally visible to visitors; hosting and content providers process information needed to supply their services.

Server-side configuration is used to keep the owner's token out of browser code. No online service can guarantee absolute security. Information may also be disclosed where required by law or necessary to address abuse or protect rights.

7. Your choices and requests

You can browse the About Me, Interests, and DNI tabs without opening the TikTok tab. You can control cookies and third-party content through your browser, although blocking them may affect video playback. Background motion can be paused and follows your reduced-motion preference; this preference is not saved as a tracking identifier.

The connected account owner can use the private setup page to disconnect, or revoke the app's access in TikTok, to stop further API retrieval. For concerns about displayed content or information you have sent, contact Milo through @nerdyleclerc on X. You may request access, correction, or deletion of information under the site's control, subject to applicable law and any necessary verification. Depending on where you live, you may also have rights to object, restrict processing, or contact a privacy regulator.

Do not post sensitive details publicly. Information held independently by TikTok, Vercel, Upstash, Google, or X must also be addressed through that provider's processes.

8. Children

This portfolio is intended for a general audience and does not knowingly solicit personal information from children. If you believe a child has supplied personal information to me through this site or a related contact, please get in touch so the concern can be reviewed.

9. Changes and contact

Changes to this policy will appear here with an updated date. For questions or privacy requests, contact Milo through @nerdyleclerc on X.
